t: A free, child-friendly environment for building media projects with drag-and-drop scripts.
steps: Download Etoys from squeakland.org and read the starting guide there.
Ask IT to install it on one test computer.
Some schools block downloads. Ask IT about Etoys To Go, which runs from a USB drive.
Linux users can look for the Flathub package.
Skip the browser version for now. Its developers do not yet recommend it for students.
Open Etoys and try a small project such as moving a drawn object.
Save a project and reopen it to check that student work is kept.
